title: Matte
recognition: Light spreads across the surface instead of forming sharp highlights.

confused_with.difference: Smooth matte looks even and low-gloss; ordinary matte means low reflectivity without implying roughness.
Stony matte appears granular / mineral. Do not equate matte with rough: texture is a separate attribute.
